name: PdxInlineEdit
description: A value the user clicks to edit in place, in the editor its `type` calls for.

members.name: type
members.description: Data type — determines which editor to show

members.name: options
members.description: Options for select/multiselect: [{ value, label }]

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Placeholder when value is empty

members.name: editOn
members.description: What opens the editor: a click on the value, a double click, or only the pencil button ('icon').

members.name: saveOn
members.description: When to save: 'blur' (auto-save on blur/Enter) | 'action' (confirm/cancel buttons)

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disabled

members.name: readonly
members.description: Readonly

members.name: size
members.description: Component size

members.name: currency
members.description: Currency code for type=currency (default: 'EUR')

members.name: precision
members.description: Decimals kept by the number and currency editors. -1: the currency's own (2 for EUR, 0 for JPY), or what the number display shows (3).

members.name: locale
members.description: Locale for formatting. Empty: the page's language (`lang`), then the browser's.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name

members.name: showIcon
members.description: Show edit icon on hover

members.name: label
members.description: The field's name, for the editor's accessible name. Empty: the inline-edit.edit component string, «Edit {value}».

members.name: value
members.description: Current value

members.name: startEdit
members.description: Open the editor, as a click on the value does. Nothing while `disabled` or `readonly`.

members.name: confirmEdit
members.description: Save the edited value and close the editor.

members.name: cancelEdit
members.description: Close the editor and keep the value; emits `pdx-cancel`.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focus what opens the editor: the value, or with `edit-on="icon"` the pencil button.

members.name: blur
members.description: Removes focus from it.

events.name: pdx-cancel
events.description: The edit was cancelled: Escape, or the cancel button. The value is unchanged.

events.name: value-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `value`. Does not bubble.

cssParts.name: root
cssParts.description: The frame around the display and the editor.

cssParts.name: display
cssParts.description: The value at rest, a `role="button"` that opens the editor; with `edit-on="icon"` it only shows the value.

cssParts.name: edit
cssParts.description: With `edit-on="icon"`, the pencil button that opens the editor, and the only thing that does.

cssParts.name: editor
cssParts.description: The editor's container, shown while editing.

cssParts.name: save
cssParts.description: The save button, with `save-on="action"`, while editing.

cssParts.name: cancel
cssParts.description: The cancel button, with `save-on="action"`, while editing.
